tips.text: Powers change at max level, not just get bigger — the Drone starts aiming, the Spinners stop resting.
The katana cuts along the way you are moving. Walking into a crowd and walking out of it are two different attacks.
The katana is free — it never spends one of your six slots, so it is always worth levelling.
You never aim anything but the blade. Where you stand is the whole decision — keep the swarm on one side of you.
Hazards flash before they arm. If you can see the ring closing, you still have time to walk out.
Shards you never touch are levels you never get. Pickup radius is quietly one of the strongest stats.
Gold-ringed elites are worth five ordinary kills and always drop something useful.
Your ultimate charges faster with cooldown reduction. Save it for the boss, not the first crowd.
Bosses change behaviour at each health threshold and shove everything away when they do.
Relics bend a run rather than simply strengthening it. Most carry a real drawback — read the second half.
You get one revive per run by default. Research Lab stasis pods add more.
You get six slots for the whole run. Two maxed powers usually beat six level-one ones.
Later sectors expect Research Lab investment. Farming an easy sector is a legitimate strategy.
If the frame rate dips late in a run, drop Quality in Settings — it thins effects, not enemies you can see.
Once all six slots are filled you can only deepen what you have. Nothing can be swapped out.
Powers do the killing; Passive Abilities make everything you already own better.
Press and hold a slot in the bottom bar to see what that power does.
